Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the RedLeaf integration looks promising and the engineering team is starting a short spike. We hit a snag on our side: procurement is taking longer than expected because our finance team needs to route a PO through an additional approver today.

Is there any possibility you can pause the demo countdown or grant a small buffer so we don't lose the work-in-progress while the PO routes? We should have the signed PO within 5 business days but I want to avoid losing momentum.

I can share the draft PO (attached) and any contact info your finance team wants to see. Appreciate any flexibility.

— Sara

Sara — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO. I pulled the engineering notes from the session and we definitely want to avoid breaking the spike.

We have two quick options:
- Short stopgap: I can authorize a 7-day trial extension (token top-up) from our side while procurement finishes. This is manual and tied to RD-2027-1142.
- Finance-friendly: If you’d prefer an invoice/PO flow, I can loop in our finance ops to accept the draft PO and issue a provisional invoice while signatures clear. That route usually takes 24–48h to get an acknowledgment.

If you want the 7-day extension, say the word and I’ll do it now. If you prefer the provisional-invoice path, loop in your AP contact and I’ll introduce Kimberly from our payments team.

Short note: I attached a stub of the provisional invoice we can issue (no charge until PO final).

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
